verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirmed a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at https://amplitude.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key), so the spec is directly downloadable. It sits alongside documented REST APIs (HTTP V2 ingestion, export, Dashboard REST, taxonomy, cohorts) that the spec plausibly describes. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or linking the spec, evidence of which APIs it covers, independent corroboration of its accuracy or usefulness for agents.
